# `bin/handoff-archive`

A tool: run it from the root of an instance (or of the kit, for the kit's own tools).
Source: [`bin/handoff-archive`](../../../bin/handoff-archive)

## What it says about itself

```text
bin/handoff-archive [--session NAME] [--quiet]

Copies the current HANDOFF.md to handoffs/YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM-<git short sha|uncommitted>-<session>.md
so that no rewrite of the handoff ever loses the previous version (LESSONS.md "`HANDOFF.md` is archived before it is touched", user direction
2026-09-16 20:55 MST). Rules:
  - never overwrites: an existing target name is an error;
  - idempotent by content: if any archive already has the same sha256 as HANDOFF.md, nothing is
    written and that file is named (exit 0), so the hook may call this on every touch;
  - <sha> is the short HEAD sha when HANDOFF.md is unchanged from HEAD, else 'uncommitted';
  - <session> is --session, else $KIT_SESSION, else 'unknown'. Local time in the name, as the
    seeded archives use.
The sandbox hook runs this before the first Write/Edit/Bash of an orchestrator session that touches
HANDOFF.md. Run it by hand before rewriting the handoff if you want a named session in the file.
```

## Lessons it cites

- → **`HANDOFF.md` is archived before it is touched**
- → **A session works on the tree it was opened in**
